description: textRPG UI Widget Catalog for layout design and visual editors

widgets.name: Top Header Bar
widgets.description: Universal header bar with game title, currency tracker, location badge, and settings button.

widgets.name: Action Commands Grid

widgets.name: D-Pad Navigation Radar

widgets.name: Player Equipment Paperdoll

widgets.name: Target / Partner Paperdoll

widgets.name: Item Details Inspector

widgets.name: Characters Present List

widgets.name: Active NPC Portrait Card

widgets.name: Items Present on Tile

widgets.name: Chronicle Event Log
widgets.description: Scrolling history of game messages, combat logs, stat changes, and environmental alerts.

widgets.name: Quest Tracker
